position_overview:
We’re hiring a Community Manager to build and run this community.

This is a builder role with real ownership. You’ll work closely with the Head of Executive & Community Engagement to grow the network, shape the member experience, and ensure the community consistently delivers value.

You’ll lead events, build member relationships, and turn conversations into actionable insights.

Requirements: 

 We are currently only able to hire candidates located in one of our location hubs: New York City, NY; Washington, DC; Seattle, WA; Miami, FL; San Francisco, CA. 

 What You’ll Do 

 Build the network: Identify and recruit the right members. Maintain a high bar for who joins and why.

 Design high-impact experiences: Run in-person and virtual sessions that drive meaningful participation and repeat engagement.

 Turn conversation into insight: Capture what matters and synthesize it into clear themes and takeaways.

 Run the system: Own the community platform, communications, and day-to-day operations.

 Drive internal leverage: Share those insights across marketing, sales, product, and strategy to inform decisions and action.

 What Success Looks Like 

A trusted, highly engaged network of senior leaders

Consistent participation and repeat attendance

Insights that influence go-to-market and strategic decisions

Strong, direct relationships with key operators

Clear impact on brand, strategic accounts, and pipeline

 What You Bring 

Experience building or scaling communities, executive programs, or high-touch customer experiences

Proactive and resourceful, with a bias toward action and a track record of making things happen

Confident communicator, comfortable engaging senior leaders

Strong operator with attention to detail and follow-through

5-8 years in community, events, or customer-facing roles

Experience in B2B, SaaS, fintech, or fraud and risk is a plus

Curious, energetic, and great at connecting people and ideas

 Why This Role Matters
